info.title: Monevo API
info.description:
REST API of a self-hosted Monevo instance. Errors use application/problem+json with a stable `code`.

## Authenticating integrations

Create a personal API token in Settings → API tokens and send it as `Authorization: Bearer mnv_pat_…`. Only operations that list `x-monevo-permissions` accept tokens, and the token must hold every listed permission. Browser clients use the session cookie and send `X-CSRF-Token` on unsafe methods.

cookieAuth.name: __Host-monevo_session
cookieAuth.description: Browser session (unsafe methods also need the `X-CSRF-Token` header).

apiToken.description: Personal API token; the operation lists the needed permissions in `x-monevo-permissions`.
